Path 2, costGOALS §4.3

Cost per task

Pricing AI the way Verkada did: per unit of work.

WHAT IT IS

Token usage from Claude responses and spans, joined to team and use-case labels, plus OpenCost allocation for the pods that host agents.

WHAT SETS IT APART

A monthly invoice tells us nothing. Cost per alert triaged or per PR merged, next to human cost, is the business case, and the metric for choosing model tier.

WHERE WE STAND

Trial alongside stage 1. ⚠️ Model prices change; read them from current pricing, not this card.

Verkada; "Clueless About the Cost of AI Model Usage?" (IBM), KubeCon NA 2026

TRIAL

Cost per task: Pricing AI the way Verkada did: per unit of work. Where we stand: Trial alongside stage 1. ⚠️ Model prices change; read them from current pricing, not this card. Verkada's figure was 33 cents an alert. We want our own number by the end of the stage-1 pilot.
